# Smart AI Bookkeeping

> Smart AI Bookkeeping automates the accounting and bookkeeping departments of small businesses for a one-time $2,500 setup, with optional upkeep from $175/month. Founded by Tim O'Rourke in Lake Bluff, Illinois, serving the North Shore and Chicago suburbs in person and clients anywhere remotely.

## Facts

- Business name: Smart AI Bookkeeping
- Founder: Tim O'Rourke
- Location: Lake Bluff, IL (North Shore / Chicago suburbs); also works with clients remotely
- Service: automating small businesses' accounting and bookkeeping departments (data entry, invoice coding, deposit matching, recurring entries, month-end close), built on Claude AI
- Price: $2,500 one-time setup per business; optional upkeep from $175/month (about one hour of upkeep a month); ongoing bookkeeping work priced separately
- Industries: restaurants, construction, medical practices, travel companies, other small businesses
- Background: ran his own accounting firm, Order Up Profits, for 10 years (mostly restaurant clients, plus construction, doctors and travel companies); Senior Accountant at Martin Brower (McDonald's global distributor), booking $500M+/month in cash transactions, leading unclaimed property audit prep that recovered $100k+, and building Alteryx automations; daily Restaurant365 user for years; full construction job costing experience (WIP schedules, progress billing, retainage, lien waivers); MS in Accounting, DePaul University
- Tim O'Rourke is not a CPA.
- Book a free call: https://calendly.com/timorourke
- Email: torourke358@hotmail.com
